name: Wilfred Dion
original_name: ウィルフレド・ディオン
source: Novice artisan that lives in Yuidora. He lost his parents in an accident a year ago and inherited their family atelier, which he now runs. His goal in life and as an artisan is "to bring smiles to people's faces".
translation: Novice artisan that lives in Yuidora. He lost his parents in an accident a year ago and inherited their family atelier, which he now runs. His goal in life and as an artisan is "to bring smiles to people's faces".
